name: OMathBorderBox
description: Represents an invisible box around an equation or part of an equation to which you can assign properties that affect the layout or mathematical formatting of the entire box. For example, a box can serve as an operator emulator with or without an alignment point, serve as a like breakpoint, have an associated argument size (argSz), or be grouped so as not to allow line breaks.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathBorderBox object.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: HideTop
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the top border of an equation's bounding box. Read/write.

properties.name: HideBot
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the bottom border of an equation's bounding box. Read/write.

properties.name: HideLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the left border of an equation's bounding box. Read/write.

properties.name: HideRight
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to hide the right border of an equation's bounding box. Read/write.

properties.name: StrikeH
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents a horizontal strikethrough. Read/write.

properties.name: StrikeV
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents a vertical strikethrough. Read/write.

properties.name: StrikeBLTR
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents a diagonal strikethrough from lower left to upper right. Read/write.

properties.name: StrikeTLBR
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents a diagonal strikethrough from upper left to lower right. Read/write.
